cohort: 54 premature triplets screened for ROP in a single maternity hospital
finding: ROP in triplets was mainly related to low gestational age and low birth weight, with no significant association found with gender or mode of conception.
mod_finding: All triplets in the study were delivered by Caesarean section.
gest_age: Premature (mean gestational age of triplets with ROP: 27.6±1.5 weeks; without ROP: 32.0±1.5 weeks)
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of triplets with ROP: 1290.0±295.2 g; without ROP: 1667.5±222.2 g
